title: Makkah Nummale Mara
intro: Dumaahi ayroorah addat, nummah farmo foocal kaxxa sadi, mango rooci sooleh suge sinni kibal luk. too diini mari foocal kak yakkem duude waah yan gibdaabina too diifu bargusaanam faxa marak. Ken gandi kaxxam gibduk suge, ken gandi kaxxam gibduk suge—takkay immay ken arraba Yalli inkittu kinnim yaysixxigeenim masoolinna. Niyâ garuq addat qiden wak, qibaadah kalalu ken marroowak, ken gibbatu amotani imaan sumaq fan korsa. tama assakat le roocih safar gorrisnay.
clues: Inki Yallal lino imaan cabnam cineemih taagah kaxxa digaalat aqayyaarneh sugne.
Ni ummatta ni fidga taggilem madudda, faxe gital ken qangiino hadliyyi takke way
Nanu ayrol qeelal waasneh sugne, uxih qibaadah cato umman xayuk sugte
Ni sabhalal ni coolaysit yuble mara kinni way cakkumsuteh
Makkah addal mango mari nee dirkissah, takkay immay nanu digga luk sugne
kullim baytem ceelak sugte wak, ni amobaxxaaqa assakat le qibaadah gaba culsa gufte
